name: heatingadvice
title: Explain device health
description: Read-only analysis of accepted device evidence. A person checks the suggested next steps; this function does not control equipment.
instructions: Describe only the supplied accepted business evidence. Separate observations from uncertainty. Suggest a short inspection sequence for the property operator; missing or old evidence requires a new observation. Do not invent current measurements, claim a repair is complete, grant access, or send equipment commands. Return a concise summary and inspection steps.

output.name: summary
output.description: What the supplied device evidence shows

output.name: nextsteps
output.description: Inspection steps for a person to review
